# Primary & Urgent Care Centers of Palm Beach County

> Walk-in urgent care and primary care clinics serving Palm Beach County, Florida. Four locations offering same-day care for car accident injuries, urgent injuries, work injuries, DOT physicals, on-site X-ray, CT scans, and primary care. Florida PIP and Emergency Medical Condition (EMC) evaluations performed by medical doctors.

## Services

- [Urgent Injury Care](https://primaryuc.com/urgent-injury-care): Walk-in evaluation for sprains, fractures, lacerations, and acute injuries.
- [Primary Care Doctor](https://primaryuc.com/primary-care-doctor): Same-day primary care visits and chronic-condition management.
- [Pain Management Care](https://primaryuc.com/pain-management-care): Conservative pain management for musculoskeletal conditions.
- [Emergency Room–Level Care](https://primaryuc.com/emergency-room): Higher-acuity capabilities available on site.
- [CT Scan](https://primaryuc.com/service/ct-scan): On-site CT imaging.
- [Nuclear Scans](https://primaryuc.com/service/nuclear-scans)
- [DOT Physical Exams](https://primaryuc.com/service/dot-physical): Certified DOT medical examiner.

## Florida Auto Insurance and PIP

Florida is a no-fault auto insurance state. Personal Injury Protection (PIP) under Fla. Stat. § 627.736 requires that an injured party receive initial medical services within 14 days of the crash to access PIP medical benefits. An Emergency Medical Condition (EMC) determination by a qualifying provider — a medical doctor (MD), doctor of osteopathic medicine (DO), physician assistant (PA), advanced practice registered nurse (APRN), or dentist — is required to unlock the full $10,000 PIP medical benefit. Without an EMC determination, PIP medical benefits are capped at $2,500.

Primary & Urgent Care Centers of Palm Beach County provide both the 14-day initial visit and the EMC certification in a single same-day appointment when clinically appropriate.
